crossRefs.note: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…

parallels.note: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice…
Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…

translations.web: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
translations.bsb: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
translations.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
translations.asv: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.
